title: STATE — deterministic FSM tracker (stub, provenance; authoritative model = src/programsmith/state.py)
description: Machine source of truth. Orchestrator routes ONLY on gate verdicts here. Amended by ADR-0038..0040 (ProgramBench pivot: EASY_SHELF terminal, ease/smoke/frontier tune counters, 'easy' status).

task_identity.description: ADR-0038: sha256(repo@sha | "programbench" | tool_name | flag_surface-hash). Legacy runs: hash(source@SHA, target_lang, scope_unit).

slug._comment: legacy slugs end in -rewrite; ProgramBench slugs are tool-derived (ADR-0038)

status._comment: 'easy' = terminal EASY_SHELF (ADR-0040): good-but-easy task, exported to <outbox>/easy/, reopenable

paused.description: operational pause/stop; halts at next inter-stage checkpoint

manifest_ref.description: pointer to the cell output blob validated for this stage

loop_counters._comment: ADR-0040 bidirectional tuning. Phase budgets are the enforced bounds (fsm.py: SMOKE_TUNE_MAX=2, FRONTIER_TUNE_MAX=1, REVISE_MAX=2); harden/ease are lifetime tallies (generation = harden+revise+ease). Old persisted states without the new keys hydrate as 0.

harden.description: lifetime harden rounds (≤ smoke+frontier budget = 3; the old 'maximum 2' predates ADR-0027/0040)

ease.description: lifetime ease rounds (ADR-0040: easing is a first-class backward move)

smoke_tunes.description: harden+ease rounds consumed at the smoke phase (CALIBRATE/QA_PROBE); SMOKE_TUNE_MAX=2

frontier_tunes.description: harden+ease rounds consumed at the frontier phase (FULL_SWEEP); FRONTIER_TUNE_MAX=1

stageName._comment: Authoritative model lives in src/programsmith/fsm.py (Stage). QA_ON_GPT and PR are LEGACY (ADR-0039): kept ONLY so pre-pivot state files load — both drain forward (no GPT QA pass, no PR opened). EASY_SHELF is a terminal (ADR-0040).
